Harper (Marketing): Quick thread to finalize format. Proposal: 35m rapid talks + 20m lab rotations (2x10m) so attendees leave with artifacts.
Noel (Host): Sounds tight but good. 10m rotations allow a short demo + Q.
Iris (Growth): Rotations are great for segmentation. We'll map choices to HubSpot props and gate the benchmark script behind CTA.
Dev (Product): Product can run 'latency profiling' rotation; Sam can run 'batching + quant' rotation with a 90s demo.
Sam (Eng): Will prepare a 90s live demo + 60s fallback gif. Example CLI: `./bench --batch=64 --quant=int8`. Need rehearsal GPU.
Tess (Speaker Ops): Speakers, please submit 2-slide bullets + demo gif by Tue COB. I'll assemble greenroom notes and timing cues.
Harper (Marketing): Draft run-of-show (PT):
```
10:00 - Welcome + housekeeping (Noel) - 3m
10:03 - Rapid context: 3 quick takes - 7m
10:10 - Rotation instructions + poll - 2m
10:12 - Rotation 1 - 10m
10:22 - Rotation 2 - 10m
10:32 - Regroup + 10m Q&A - 10m
10:42 - CTA + download links - 3m
```
Iris (Growth): Suggest adding an in-keynote poll to route people into rotations. Use poll data to tag leads.
InfraBot: rehearsal-env provisioned: rwdw-rotations-177777. Recording endpoints enabled.
Harper (Marketing): Action items: 1) speakers -> bullets + gif (Tess); 2) Sam -> live + fallback; 3) Iris -> HubSpot mapping; 4) Noel -> host script. Rehearsals: tech check = 1777850000, full dress = 1777936400.
Noel (Host): I'll update invites and landing page sections. Locking format unless objections. :thumbsup:
